♥️ B- Movie Fanatics! ♥️

Embrace the jaw-dropping oddity that is ‘AMERICAN RICKSHAW’ that reaches new levels of insanity by the minute!
 

Miami just got hotter…and weirder…

After a stripper tricks him into filming a sex tape, Miami rickshaw runner Scott Edwards becomes embroiled in the murder of a televangelist’s son when he inadvertently takes the wrong videotape. With the help of the stripper and a witch, Edwards sets out to clear his name while avoiding the assassin dead-set on retrieving the tape.

 

Directed by Giallo Maestro Sergio Martino, this movie has everything you'll ever need and way way more! 

A movie where logic has no business with its drugged up hybrid of genres, prepare for Black Magic, sex tape blackmails, Conspiracies & murders, mystical cats, a granny witch, shady televangelists, fruity rickshaw drivers, Donald Pleasance in a wig oinking and some body horror, thrown in for good measure!!!

 

Its an irrationally insane, incredibily incoherent bag of ideas that will leave you wondering “Did I dream this?” 

 

Never been to a Witch Of Popcorn Night?

Audience Participation: We don’t want you just watching; we want you living the American Rickshaw experience. Get ready brain melting nonesense!
